title: Grade 1–5
blurb: The first few thousand words: short, everyday, and the ones everything else is built on.

title: Grade 6–8
blurb: Middle-school English — longer words, and the first abstract ones.

title: Grade 9–10
blurb: The vocabulary secondary-school reading and writing starts to assume.

title: Grade 11–12
blurb: Higher-secondary English: argument, analysis and the words essays need.

title: University
blurb: Academic register — the words lectures, papers and seminars run on.

title: IELTS General Training
blurb: The everyday and workplace English GT tests, rather than the academic register of Academic.

title: IELTS
blurb: Academic vocabulary that carries marks in Writing Task 2 and Reading.

title: SAT
blurb: The judgement-and-degree words American college tests keep coming back to.

title: Admission (BD)
blurb: Synonym-and-antonym drilling for Bangladeshi university admission tests.

title: Job & Workplace
blurb: Interviews, email, contracts and the language of getting things done.

title: Native & Everyday
blurb: The plain, high-frequency words that make speech sound unforced.

title: Elite
blurb: Rare and literary words — the ones that make a reader stop.

title: Science & Medicine
blurb: The vocabulary of labs, bodies and papers — useful well beyond exams.

title: Compounds & Phrases
blurb: Hyphenated and multi-word entries — the ones dictionaries hide at the back.
